```{r global-theme, include=FALSE}
# Set global theme for all plots
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial", base_size = 12))

page_break <- function() {
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    htmltools::HTML('<div style="page-break-after: always;"></div>')
  } else {
    cat("\n\\newpage\n")
  }
}


render_tbl <- function(tbl_gt_or_df, use_gt = TRUE) {
  if (knitr::is_html_output() && use_gt) {
    return(tbl_gt_or_df)
  } else {
    if (inherits(tbl_gt_or_df, "gtsummary")) {
      return(as_flex_table(tbl_gt_or_df))
    } else if (inherits(tbl_gt_or_df, "gt_tbl")) {
      df <- try(gt::dt_data_get(tbl_gt_or_df), silent = TRUE)
      if (inherits(df, "try-error") || is.null(df)) {
        df <- try(tbl_gt_or_df[["_data"]], silent = TRUE)  # older gt versions
      }
      if (inherits(df, "try-error") || is.null(df)) {
        df <- try(gt::dt_body_get(tbl_gt_or_df), silent = TRUE)  # body rows
      }
      df <- tibble::as_tibble(df)
      return(flextable::autofit(flextable::flextable(df)))
    } else if (is.data.frame(tbl_gt_or_df)) {
      return(flextable::autofit(flextable::flextable(tbl_gt_or_df)))
    } else {
      return(tbl_gt_or_df)
    }
  }
}
```

# Figure 1: Cohort Flow Diagram

```{r figure1-consort, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
fc <- counts$final_cohort_breakdown
get_count <- function(nm) if (nm %in% names(fc)) as.integer(fc[[nm]]) else 0L

breakdown_text <- paste0(
  "<50 sequence: ", get_count("<50 sequence"), "\\n",
  "≥50 sequence: ", get_count("≥50 sequence"), "\\n",
  "AOOS: ", get_count("AOOS (out-of-sequence)")
)

consort_diagram <- grViz(glue("
digraph consort {{
  graph [rankdir = TB, splines = ortho, nodesep=0.35, ranksep=0.45]
  node [shape=box, style='rounded,filled', fillcolor='white', color='#666666', fontname='Arial', fontsize=10]
  edge [color='#666666', arrowsize=0.6]

  A [label='All transplanted patients (STAR/PTR)\\nJan 2018 - April 2025\\nN = {format(counts$n_initial, big.mark=',')}', fillcolor='#F8F8F8']
  B [label='With accepted offer records\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_join, big.mark=',')}']
  C [label='After multi-organ exclusions\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_multiorg, big.mark=',')}']
  D [label='After living donor exclusions\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_living, big.mark=',')}']
  E [label='After split liver exclusions\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_split, big.mark=',')}']
  F [label='After donor deduplication\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_dedup, big.mark=',')}']
  G [label='After directed donation exclusions\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_directed, big.mark=',')}']
  H [label='Final analysis cohort\\nN = {format(counts$n_final, big.mark=',')}\\n\\n{breakdown_text}', fillcolor='#EFEFEF']

  X1 [label='Excluded:\\nOffers not in PTR dataset\\n(large portion are living donors)\\nN = {format(counts$n_initial - counts$n_after_join, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='#FFE6E6', color='#CC0000']
  X2 [label='Excluded:\\nMulti-organ transplants\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_join - counts$n_after_multiorg, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='white', color='#AAAAAA']
  X3 [label='Excluded:\\nLiving donor transplants\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_multiorg - counts$n_after_living, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='white', color='#AAAAAA']
  X4 [label='Excluded:\\nSplit liver cases\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_living - counts$n_after_split, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='white', color='#AAAAAA']
  X5 [label='Excluded:\\nDuplicate donors\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_split - counts$n_after_dedup, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='white', color='#AAAAAA']
  X6 [label='Excluded:\\nDirected donations\\nN = {format(counts$n_after_dedup - counts$n_after_directed, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='white', color='#AAAAAA']
  X7 [label='Excluded:\\nMissing MELD: {counts$n_excluded_meld}\\nMissing donor data: {counts$n_excluded_donor}\\nTotal N = {format(counts$n_before_step9 - counts$n_final, big.mark=',')}', shape=note, fillcolor='white', color='#AAAAAA']

  A -> B; B -> C; C -> D; D -> E; E -> F; F -> G; G -> H
  A -> X1 [arrowhead=none, color='#CC0000', style=bold]
  B -> X2 [arrowhead=none, color='#BBBBBB']
  C -> X3 [arrowhead=none, color='#BBBBBB']
  D -> X4 [arrowhead=none, color='#BBBBBB']
  E -> X5 [arrowhead=none, color='#BBBBBB']
  F -> X6 [arrowhead=none, color='#BBBBBB']
  G -> X7 [arrowhead=none, color='#BBBBBB']
}}
"))

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  consort_diagram
} else {
  tmp_png <- file.path(tempdir(), "consort_diagram.png")
  consort_diagram %>%
    DiagrammeRsvg::export_svg() %>%
    charToRaw() %>%
    rsvg::rsvg_png(tmp_png, width = 4800, height = 4000)

}
```

**Figure 1. Cohort flow diagram showing construction and exclusions.** Starting with all liver transplants from January 2018 to April 2025, sequential exclusion criteria were applied to create the final analysis cohort of `r format(counts$n_final, big.mark=",")` cases.

# Table 1: Baseline Characteristics

```{r table1-data-prep}
final_cohort <- final_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    donation_type = case_when(
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("Y", "YES", "1", "TRUE") ~ "DCD",
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("N", "NO", "0", "FALSE") ~ "DBD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MACRO_FAT_CAT = {
      v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_donor))
      case_when(
        is.na(v) ~ NA_character_,
        v == 0 ~ "0%",
        v > 0 & v < 30 ~ "1-29%",
        v >= 30 & v < 60 ~ "30-59%",
        v >= 60 ~ "≥60%"
      ) %>% factor(levels = c("0%", "1-29%", "30-59%", "≥60%"))
    }
  )
```

```{r table1}
tbl1 <- final_cohort %>%
  select(
    seq_flag,
    AGE, MELD_PELD_ADJ, GENDER,
    AGE_DON_donor, donation_type, BMI_DON_CALC_donor,
    MACRO_FAT_CAT, TBILI_DON_donor, SGOT_DON, SGPT_DON,
    DRI, DSRI,
    COLD_ISCH_num, WAIT_DAYS, DISTANCE, n_unique_ctr_contacted
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = seq_flag,
    label = list(
      AGE ~ "Recipient age (years)",
      MELD_PELD_ADJ ~ "Recipient MELD/PELD",
      GENDER ~ "Recipient gender",
      AGE_DON_donor ~ "Donor age (years)",
      donation_type ~ "Donation type",
      BMI_DON_CALC_donor ~ "Donor BMI (kg/m²)",
      MACRO_FAT_CAT ~ "Donor macrosteatosis",
      TBILI_DON_donor ~ "Donor bilirubin (mg/dL)",
      SGOT_DON ~ "Donor AST (U/L)",
      SGPT_DON ~ "Donor ALT (U/L)",
      DRI ~ "Donor Risk Index",
      DSRI ~ "Discard Risk Index",
      COLD_ISCH_num ~ "Cold ischemia time (hours)",
      WAIT_DAYS ~ "Wait time (days)",
      DISTANCE ~ "Distance (nautical miles)",
      n_unique_ctr_contacted ~ "Centers contacted"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous() ~ 1,
      DRI ~ 2,
      DSRI ~ 2
    ),
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
  add_p(
    test = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "kruskal.test",
      all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test"
    )
  ) %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 1. Baseline Characteristics by Sequence Group**") %>%
  modify_footnote(
    all_stat_cols() ~ "Median (IQR) for continuous variables; n (%) for categorical variables"
  ) %>%
  modify_source_note(
    "P-values: Kruskal-Wallis test for continuous variables; Pearson chi-square for categorical variables"
  )

tbl1
```

# Figure 2: Offer Characteristics by Type

```{r fig2-data-prep}
seq_plot_df <- final_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    offer_group = if_else(is_open_offer, "Open offer", "Sequential"),
    offer_group = factor(offer_group, levels = c("Sequential", "Open offer")),
    seq_num = PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(seq_num), seq_num >= 1)

centres_plot_df <- final_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    offer_group = if_else(is_open_offer, "Open offer", "Sequential"),
    offer_group = factor(offer_group, levels = c("Sequential", "Open offer")),
    n_ctr = n_unique_ctr_contacted
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_ctr), n_ctr >= 1)

n_total_seq <- seq_plot_df %>% count(offer_group)
n_total_ctr <- centres_plot_df %>% count(offer_group)

seq_stats <- seq_plot_df %>%
  group_by(offer_group) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(seq_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    p25 = quantile(seq_num, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75 = quantile(seq_num, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(txt = paste0(offer_group, ": ", comma(med), " (", comma(p25), "–", comma(p75), ")"))

ctr_stats <- centres_plot_df %>%
  group_by(offer_group) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(n_ctr, na.rm = TRUE),
    p25 = quantile(n_ctr, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75 = quantile(n_ctr, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(txt = paste0(offer_group, ": ", comma(med), " (", comma(p25), "–", comma(p75), ")"))
```

```{r fig2-panel-a, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
ymax_seq <- max(seq_plot_df$seq_num, na.rm = TRUE)

pA <- ggplot(seq_plot_df, aes(x = offer_group, y = seq_num)) +
  geom_violin(width = 0.9, trim = TRUE, colour = "grey20", fill = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    data = n_total_seq,

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1, ymax_seq * 1.08)) +

    x = NULL,
    y = "Sequence at acceptance (log₁₀ scale)",

  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

  )
```

```{r fig2-panel-b, fig.width=5, fig.height=6}
ymax_ctr <- max(centres_plot_df$n_ctr, na.rm = TRUE)
y_top_ctr <- max(25, ceiling(ymax_ctr / 5) * 5)

pB <- ggplot(centres_plot_df, aes(x = offer_group, y = n_ctr)) +
```

**Figure 2. Offer characteristics by offer type.** (A) Distribution of sequence number at acceptance for AOOS offers versus sequential offers. (B) Distribution of unique centers contacted before acceptance. AOOS offers bypass sequential allocation and are typically accepted later in the match run.

# Figure 3: Yearly Distribution of Transplants

```{r fig3-yearly-data}
# Calculate yearly totals for caption
yearly_totals <- final_cohort %>%
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(TX_DATE)) %>%
  count(year, name = "total")

levs <- c("<50", "≥50", "AOOS")
plot_df <- final_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(TX_DATE),
    seq_group = case_when(
      is_open_offer ~ "AOOS",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx < 50 ~ "<50",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 50 ~ "≥50"
    ) %>% factor(levels = levs)
  ) %>%
  count(year, seq_group) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(year, seq_group, fill = list(n = 0, prop = 0))

colors <- c("<50" = "#2166AC", "≥50" = "#5AAE61", "AOOS" = "#D73027")
```

```{r fig3-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
gg_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = factor(year), y = prop, fill = seq_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(prop < 0.025, "", scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1))),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    colour = "white", size = 3, fontface = "bold", family = "Arial"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),

  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colors,
    name = "Offer Type",
    labels = c("<50" = "Sequence <50", "≥50" = "Sequence ≥50", "AOOS" = "AOOS")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Proportion of Transplants (%)",
    title = "Yearly Distribution of Liver Transplants by Offer Type"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(
    title.position = "top",
    title.hjust = 0.5,
    nrow = 1
  ))

gg_plot
```

# Figure 4: Placement Time and Clamp Timing by Sequence

```{r fig4-data-prep}
timing_cohort <- final_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    placement_time_hours = case_when(
      is.na(earliest_init) ~ NA_real_,
      is.na(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(difftime(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx, earliest_init, units = "hours"))
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx),
    as.Date(FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx) <= TX_DATE,
    !is.na(placement_time_hours),
    !is.na(diff_final_clamp),
    earliest_init <= FINAL_RESPONSE_DT_tx
  )

timing_n <- nrow(timing_cohort)

timing_summary <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    sequence_bin = case_when(
      seq_flag == "AOOS (out-of-sequence)" ~ "AOOS",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx == 1 ~ "1",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx == 2 ~ "2",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx == 3 ~ "3",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx == 4 ~ "4",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx == 5 ~ "5",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 6 & PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx <= 10 ~ "6-10",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 11 & PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx <= 20 ~ "11-20",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 21 & PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx <= 30 ~ "21-30",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 31 & PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx <= 50 ~ "31-50",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 51 & PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx <= 100 ~ "51-100",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx >= 101 & PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx <= 500 ~ "101-500",
      PTR_SEQUENCE_NUM_tx > 500 ~ "500+",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(sequence_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs = n(),
    placement_time_median = median(placement_time_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    clamp_timing_median = median(diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

seq_order <- c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6-10", "11-20", "21-30", 
               "31-50", "51-100", "101-500", "500+", "AOOS")

timing_summary <- timing_summary %>%
  mutate(sequence_bin = factor(sequence_bin, levels = seq_order)) %>%
  arrange(sequence_bin)

y1_min <- min(timing_summary$placement_time_median, na.rm = TRUE)
y1_max <- max(timing_summary$placement_time_median, na.rm = TRUE)
y2_min <- min(timing_summary$clamp_timing_median, na.rm = TRUE)
y2_max <- max(timing_summary$clamp_timing_median, na.rm = TRUE)

scale_factor <- (y1_max - y1_min) / (y2_max - y2_min)
to_primary <- function(y) (y - y2_min) * scale_factor + y1_min
to_secondary <- function(y) (y - y1_min) / scale_factor + y2_min

plot_data <- timing_summary %>%
  mutate(
    clamp_on_primary = to_primary(clamp_timing_median),
    is_aoos = sequence_bin == "AOOS"
  )
```

```{r fig4-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
p_dual <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = sequence_bin, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = placement_time_median, colour = "Placement time"), 
            linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = placement_time_median, colour = "Placement time"), 
             size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = clamp_on_primary, colour = "Clamp timing"),
            linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(y = clamp_on_primary, colour = "Clamp timing"),
             shape = 15, size = 2) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(plot_data, is_aoos),
    aes(y = placement_time_median),
    shape = 8, size = 4, colour = "#1f77b4"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(plot_data, is_aoos),
    aes(y = clamp_on_primary),
    shape = 8, size = 4, colour = "#d62728"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Placement time (hours, median)",
    breaks = seq(0, ceiling(y1_max), 2),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ to_secondary(.),
      name = "Clamp timing (hours relative to cross-clamp, median)",
      breaks = seq(floor(y2_min), 0, 2)
    )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    NULL,
    values = c("Placement time" = "#1f77b4", "Clamp timing" = "#d62728")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Sequence bin",
    title = "Placement Time vs Clamp Timing Across Sequence Bins"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
```

# Figure 5: Response Timing by Donor Type and Sequence

```{r fig5-data-prep}
final_plot_data <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    donation_type = case_when(
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("Y", "YES", "1", "TRUE") ~ "DCD",
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("N", "NO", "0", "FALSE") ~ "DBD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(donation_type), !is.na(seq_flag))

sequence_colors <- c(
  "<50 sequence" = "#00468B", 
  "≥50 sequence" = "#ED0000", 
  "AOOS (out-of-sequence)" = "#42B540"
)

# Calculate medians for caption
box_medians <- final_plot_data %>%
  group_by(donation_type, seq_flag) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(diff_final_clamp, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(diff_final_clamp, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

make_cumulative_plot <- function(data, donor_type_filter, plot_label) {
  plot_data <- data %>% filter(donation_type == donor_type_filter)
  max_val <- max(plot_data$diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = diff_final_clamp, color = seq_flag)) +
    stat_ecdf(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", 
               linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-50, max_val)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = sequence_colors, name = "Sequence Group") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), 
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(plot_label, ": ", donor_type_filter, " Donors"),
      x = "Hours from Cross-Clamp",
      y = "Cumulative Proportion"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.05, label = "Cross-clamp", 
             angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.5, 
             fontface = "bold", color = "grey30")
}

make_boxplot <- function(data, plot_label) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = donation_type, y = diff_final_clamp, fill = seq_flag)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", 
               alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_boxplot(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), 
      alpha = 0.8, 
      outlier.alpha = 0.4, 
      outlier.size = 0.8, 
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sequence_colors, name = "Sequence Group") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-50, max(data$diff_final_clamp, na.rm = TRUE))) +
    labs(
      title = plot_label,
      x = "Donation Type",
      y = "Hours from Cross-Clamp"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.7, y = 2, label = "Cross-clamp", 
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", 
             color = "grey30")
}

make_proportion_plot <- function(data) {
  prop_data <- data %>%
    group_by(donation_type, seq_flag) %>%
    summarise(
      n_post = sum(diff_final_clamp > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      total = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      prop = (n_post / total) * 100,
      label = paste0(n_post, "/", total, "\n(", round(prop, 1), "%)")
    )
  
  ggplot(prop_data, aes(x = donation_type, y = prop, fill = seq_flag)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label), 
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), 
      vjust = -0.3, 
      size = 2.5, 
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sequence_colors, name = "Sequence Group") +
    labs(
      title = "D. Post-Clamp Final Response Proportion",
      x = "Donation Type",
      y = "Post-Clamp Final Response (%)"
    ) +
    ylim(0, max(prop_data$prop) * 1.2) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    )
}
```

# Figure 6: Survival by Donor Type and Sequence Group

```{r fig6-survival-prep}
surv_df <- final_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    seq_flag = factor(seq_flag, levels = c("<50 sequence", "≥50 sequence", "AOOS (out-of-sequence)")),
    PTIME_yrs = PTIME / 365.25,
    GTIME_yrs = GTIME / 365.25,
    donation_type = case_when(
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("Y", "YES", "1", "TRUE") ~ "DCD",
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("N", "NO", "0", "FALSE") ~ "DBD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    donation_type = factor(donation_type, levels = c("DBD", "DCD"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(donation_type), !is.na(PSTATUS), !is.na(GSTATUS)) %>%
  droplevels()

sequence_colors <- c(
  "<50 sequence" = "#00468B", 
  "≥50 sequence" = "#ED0000", 
  "AOOS (out-of-sequence)" = "#42B540"
)

surv_dcd <- surv_df %>% filter(donation_type == "DCD") %>% droplevels()
surv_dbd <- surv_df %>% filter(donation_type == "DBD") %>% droplevels()

surv_dcd$seq_flag <- relevel(surv_dcd$seq_flag, ref = "<50 sequence")
surv_dbd$seq_flag <- relevel(surv_dbd$seq_flag, ref = "<50 sequence")

fit_patient_dcd <- survfit(Surv(PTIME_yrs, PSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dcd)
fit_graft_dcd <- survfit(Surv(GTIME_yrs, GSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dcd)
fit_patient_dbd <- survfit(Surv(PTIME_yrs, PSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dbd)
fit_graft_dbd <- survfit(Surv(GTIME_yrs, GSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dbd)

labs_short <- c("<50", "≥50", "AOOS")
pal <- unname(sequence_colors)
```

# Figure 7: Graft Survival by Cross-Clamp Timing

```{r fig7-prep}
dcd_oos <- timing_cohort %>% filter(donation_type=="DCD", seq_flag=="AOOS (out-of-sequence)")
dbd_oos <- timing_cohort %>% filter(donation_type=="DBD", seq_flag=="AOOS (out-of-sequence)")
dcd_seq <- timing_cohort %>% filter(donation_type=="DCD", seq_flag %in% c("<50 sequence","≥50 sequence"))
dbd_seq <- timing_cohort %>% filter(donation_type=="DBD", seq_flag %in% c("<50 sequence","≥50 sequence"))

timing_cohort <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    donation_type = case_when(
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("Y","YES","1","TRUE") ~ "DCD",
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("N","NO","0","FALSE") ~ "DBD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    clamp_timing = case_when(
      diff_final_clamp >  0 ~ "Post cross-clamp",
      diff_final_clamp <= 0 ~ "Pre cross-clamp",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Pre cross-clamp", "Post cross-clamp")),
    GTIME_yrs = GTIME / 365.25,
    PTIME_yrs = PTIME / 365.25,
    GTIME_1yr = pmin(GTIME_yrs, 1),
    PTIME_1yr = pmin(PTIME_yrs, 1),
    GSTATUS_1yr = ifelse(GTIME_yrs > 1, 0, GSTATUS),
    PSTATUS_1yr = ifelse(PTIME_yrs > 1, 0, PSTATUS)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(donation_type), !is.na(clamp_timing),
    !is.na(GTIME_yrs), !is.na(GSTATUS),
    !is.na(PTIME_yrs), !is.na(PSTATUS)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()

dcd_oos <- timing_cohort %>% filter(donation_type=="DCD", seq_flag=="AOOS (out-of-sequence)")
dbd_oos <- timing_cohort %>% filter(donation_type=="DBD", seq_flag=="AOOS (out-of-sequence)")
dcd_seq <- timing_cohort %>% filter(donation_type=="DCD", seq_flag %in% c("<50 sequence","≥50 sequence"))
dbd_seq <- timing_cohort %>% filter(donation_type=="DBD", seq_flag %in% c("<50 sequence","≥50 sequence"))

clamp_cols <- c("Pre cross-clamp"="#32CD32", "Post cross-clamp"="#8B0000")

fit_g_dcd_oos <- survfit(Surv(GTIME_1yr, GSTATUS_1yr) ~ clamp_timing, data = dcd_oos)
fit_g_dbd_oos <- survfit(Surv(GTIME_1yr, GSTATUS_1yr) ~ clamp_timing, data = dbd_oos)
fit_g_dcd_seq <- survfit(Surv(GTIME_1yr, GSTATUS_1yr) ~ clamp_timing, data = dcd_seq)
fit_g_dbd_seq <- survfit(Surv(GTIME_1yr, GSTATUS_1yr) ~ clamp_timing, data = dbd_seq)
```

# Figure 8: Multinomial Regression Predictors

```{r fig8-multinom-prep, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
# ============================================================================
# DATA PREPARATION WITH EXCLUSION TRACKING
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== DATA PREPARATION FOR MULTINOMIAL MODEL ===\n")

# Initialize exclusion tracker
starting_n <- nrow(timing_cohort)
exclusion_tracker <- tibble(
  step = character(),
  n_excluded = numeric(),
  n_remaining = numeric(),
  reason = character()
)

cat("Starting cohort: timing_cohort with", comma(starting_n), "observations\n\n")

# Derive all variables first
multinom_data <- timing_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_binned = case_when(
      is.na(MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_donor) ~ "Unknown",
      MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_donor >= 0 & MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_donor < 10 ~ "0-10%",
      MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_donor >= 10 & MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_donor < 30 ~ "10-30%",
      MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_donor >= 30 & MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_donor < 60 ~ "30-60%",
      MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_donor >= 60 ~ "≥60%"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("0-10%", "10-30%", "30-60%", "≥60%", "Unknown")),
    
    LI_FIBROSIS_collapsed = case_when(
      is.na(LI_FIBROSIS) ~ "Unknown",
      LI_FIBROSIS %in% c("0") ~ "None",
      LI_FIBROSIS %in% c("1", "2") ~ "Mild",
      LI_FIBROSIS %in% c("3", "4", "5", "6") ~ "Moderate-Severe"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("None", "Mild", "Moderate-Severe", "Unknown")),
    
    SGOT_DON_binned = case_when(
      is.na(SGOT_DON) ~ NA_character_,
      SGOT_DON < 100 ~ "Normal (<100 U/L)",
      SGOT_DON >= 100 & SGOT_DON < 500 ~ "Mild (100-499 U/L)",
      SGOT_DON >= 500 & SGOT_DON < 1000 ~ "Moderate (500-999 U/L)",
      SGOT_DON >= 1000 ~ "Severe (≥1000 U/L)"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Normal (<100 U/L)", "Mild (100-499 U/L)", 
                            "Moderate (500-999 U/L)", "Severe (≥1000 U/L)")),
    
    SGPT_DON_binned = case_when(
      is.na(SGPT_DON) ~ NA_character_,
      SGPT_DON < 100 ~ "Normal (<100 U/L)",
      SGPT_DON >= 100 & SGPT_DON < 500 ~ "Mild (100-499 U/L)",
      SGPT_DON >= 500 & SGPT_DON < 1000 ~ "Moderate (500-999 U/L)",
      SGPT_DON >= 1000 ~ "Severe (≥1000 U/L)"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Normal (<100 U/L)", "Mild (100-499 U/L)", 
                            "Moderate (500-999 U/L)", "Severe (≥1000 U/L)")),
    
    TBILI_DON_binned = case_when(
      is.na(TBILI_DON_donor) ~ NA_character_,
      TBILI_DON_donor < 1.5 ~ "Normal (<1.5 mg/dL)",
      TBILI_DON_donor >= 1.5 & TBILI_DON_donor < 3.0 ~ "Mild (1.5-2.9 mg/dL)",
      TBILI_DON_donor >= 3.0 & TBILI_DON_donor < 5.0 ~ "Moderate (3.0-4.9 mg/dL)",
      TBILI_DON_donor >= 5.0 ~ "Severe (≥5.0 mg/dL)"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Normal (<1.5 mg/dL)", "Mild (1.5-2.9 mg/dL)", 
                            "Moderate (3.0-4.9 mg/dL)", "Severe (≥5.0 mg/dL)")),
    
    CREAT_DON_binned = case_when(
      is.na(CREAT_DON) ~ NA_character_,
      CREAT_DON < 1.2 ~ "Normal (<1.2 mg/dL)",
      CREAT_DON >= 1.2 & CREAT_DON < 2.0 ~ "Mild dysfunction (1.2-1.9 mg/dL)",
      CREAT_DON >= 2.0 & CREAT_DON < 3.0 ~ "Moderate dysfunction (2.0-2.9 mg/dL)",
      CREAT_DON >= 3.0 ~ "Severe dysfunction (≥3.0 mg/dL)"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Normal (<1.2 mg/dL)", "Mild dysfunction (1.2-1.9 mg/dL)", 
                            "Moderate dysfunction (2.0-2.9 mg/dL)", "Severe dysfunction (≥3.0 mg/dL)")),
    
    DEATH_MECH_DON_collapsed = case_when(
      is.na(DEATH_MECH_DON) ~ "Unknown",
      DEATH_MECH_DON %in% c("1") ~ "Anoxia",
      DEATH_MECH_DON %in% c("2") ~ "CVA",
      DEATH_MECH_DON %in% c("3") ~ "Head trauma",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Anoxia", "CVA", "Head trauma", "Other", "Unknown")),
    
    DEATH_CIRCUM_DON_collapsed = case_when(
      is.na(DEATH_CIRCUM_DON) ~ "Unknown",
      DEATH_CIRCUM_DON %in% c("1") ~ "MVA",
      DEATH_CIRCUM_DON %in% c("2") ~ "Suicide",
      DEATH_CIRCUM_DON %in% c("3") ~ "Homicide",
      DEATH_CIRCUM_DON %in% c("4") ~ "Child abuse",
      DEATH_CIRCUM_DON %in% c("5") ~ "Accident, Non-MVA",
      DEATH_CIRCUM_DON %in% c("6") ~ "Natural causes",
      DEATH_CIRCUM_DON %in% c("997") ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("MVA", "Suicide", "Homicide", "Child abuse", 
                            "Accident, Non-MVA", "Natural causes", "Other", "Unknown")),
    
    AGE_DON_binned = case_when(
      AGE_DON_donor < 40 ~ "<40",
      AGE_DON_donor >= 40 & AGE_DON_donor < 50 ~ "40-49",
      AGE_DON_donor >= 50 & AGE_DON_donor < 60 ~ "50-59",
      AGE_DON_donor >= 60 & AGE_DON_donor < 70 ~ "60-69",
      AGE_DON_donor >= 70 ~ "≥70"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("<40", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "≥70")),
    
    AGE_binned = case_when(
      AGE < 40 ~ "<40",
      AGE >= 40 & AGE < 50 ~ "40-49",
      AGE >= 50 & AGE < 60 ~ "50-59",
      AGE >= 60 & AGE < 70 ~ "60-69",
      AGE >= 70 ~ "≥70"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("<40", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "≥70")),
    
    donation_type = case_when(
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("Y", "YES", "1", "TRUE") ~ "DCD",
      NON_HRT_DON_donor %in% c("N", "NO", "0", "FALSE") ~ "DBD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("DBD", "DCD")),
    
    pre_clamp_hours = ifelse(diff_final_clamp < 0, abs(diff_final_clamp), 0),
    post_clamp_hours = ifelse(diff_final_clamp > 0, diff_final_clamp, 0),
    
    HCV_NAT_DON = factor(HCV_NAT_DON, levels = c("N", "P")),
    HEP_C_ANTI_DON = factor(HEP_C_ANTI_DON, levels = c("N", "P")),
    CDC_RISK_HIV_DON = factor(CDC_RISK_HIV_DON, levels = c("N", "Y")),
    HBV_CORE_DON = factor(HBV_CORE_DON, levels = c("N", "P")),
    
    ASCITES_TX = factor(ASCITES_TX),
    ENCEPH_TX = factor(ENCEPH_TX),
    DIAB = factor(DIAB),
    GENDER = factor(GENDER),
    ETHCAT = factor(ETHCAT),
    
    TX_YEAR = as.numeric(format(TX_DATE, "%Y")),
    
    seq_flag = relevel(factor(seq_flag), ref = "<50 sequence")
  ) %>%
  select(
    seq_flag, TX_YEAR, AGE_DON_binned, BMI_DON_CALC_donor, 
    SGOT_DON_binned, SGPT_DON_binned, TBILI_DON_binned, CREAT_DON_binned,
    donation_type, DRI, DSRI,
    HCV_NAT_DON, HEP_C_ANTI_DON, CDC_RISK_HIV_DON, HBV_CORE_DON,
    MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_binned, LI_FIBROSIS_collapsed, 
    DEATH_CIRCUM_DON_collapsed, DEATH_MECH_DON_collapsed,
    GENDER_DON_donor, ABO_DON, ALCOHOL_HEAVY_DON_donor,
    CLIN_INFECT_DON, HIST_DIABETES_DON, HIST_HYPERTENS_DON,
    HIST_CANCER_DON, HIST_CAD, SODIUM170_VAL_DON, BLOOD_INF_DON,
    AGE_binned, GENDER, ETHCAT, BMI_CALC, MELD_PELD_ADJ,
    ASCITES_TX, ENCEPH_TX, DIAB, DAYSWAIT_CHRON,
    pre_clamp_hours, post_clamp_hours,
    OPO_CTR_CODE, LISTING_CTR_CODE
  )

# track exclusions step by step

# ============================================================================
# FIT MODEL FOR FIGURE 8
# ============================================================================

model_clinical <- multinom(
  seq_flag ~ 
    TX_YEAR + AGE_DON_binned + BMI_DON_CALC_donor + 
    SGOT_DON_binned + SGPT_DON_binned + TBILI_DON_binned + CREAT_DON_binned +
    donation_type + DRI + DSRI +
    HCV_NAT_DON + HEP_C_ANTI_DON + CDC_RISK_HIV_DON + HBV_CORE_DON +
    MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_binned + LI_FIBROSIS_collapsed +
    DEATH_CIRCUM_DON_collapsed + DEATH_MECH_DON_collapsed +
    GENDER_DON_donor + ABO_DON + ALCOHOL_HEAVY_DON_donor +
    CLIN_INFECT_DON + HIST_DIABETES_DON + HIST_HYPERTENS_DON +
    HIST_CANCER_DON + HIST_CAD + SODIUM170_VAL_DON + BLOOD_INF_DON +
    AGE_binned + GENDER + ETHCAT + BMI_CALC + MELD_PELD_ADJ +
    ASCITES_TX + ENCEPH_TX + DIAB + DAYSWAIT_CHRON +
    pre_clamp_hours + post_clamp_hours,
  data = multinom_data,
  maxit = 1000,
  trace = FALSE
)

coef_matrix <- coef(model_clinical)
se_matrix <- summary(model_clinical)$standard.errors

dsri_decile <- quantile(multinom_data$DSRI, 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)

increment_map <- c(
  "BMI_DON_CALC_donor" = 5,
  "DRI" = 0.5,
  "DSRI" = dsri_decile,
  "BMI_CALC" = 5,
  "MELD_PELD_ADJ" = 5,
  "DAYSWAIT_CHRON" = 180,
  "pre_clamp_hours" = 4,
  "post_clamp_hours" = 0.5
)

rescale_rrr <- function(coef, se, term) {
  if (term %in% names(increment_map)) {
    increment <- increment_map[term]
    scaled_coef <- coef * increment
    scaled_se <- se * increment
  } else {
    scaled_coef <- coef
    scaled_se <- se
  }
  
  list(
    rrr = exp(scaled_coef),
    rrr_ci_low = exp(scaled_coef - 1.96 * scaled_se),
    rrr_ci_high = exp(scaled_coef + 1.96 * scaled_se)
  )
}

z_matrix <- coef_matrix / se_matrix
p_matrix <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_matrix)))

tidy_gte50 <- tibble(
  term = rownames(t(coef_matrix)),
  coefficient = coef_matrix[1, ],
  se = se_matrix[1, ],
  z = z_matrix[1, ],
  p = p_matrix[1, ]
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    scaled = list(rescale_rrr(coefficient, se, term)),
    rrr = scaled$rrr,
    rrr_ci_low = scaled$rrr_ci_low,
    rrr_ci_high = scaled$rrr_ci_high
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-scaled) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = "≥50 vs <50 sequence",
    significant = p < 0.05
  )

tidy_aoos <- tibble(
  term = rownames(t(coef_matrix)),
  coefficient = coef_matrix[2, ],
  se = se_matrix[2, ],
  z = z_matrix[2, ],
  p = p_matrix[2, ]
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    scaled = list(rescale_rrr(coefficient, se, term)),
    rrr = scaled$rrr,
    rrr_ci_low = scaled$rrr_ci_low,
    rrr_ci_high = scaled$rrr_ci_high
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-scaled) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = "AOOS vs <50 sequence",
    significant = p < 0.05
  )

key_vars <- c(
  "BMI_DON_CALC_donor", "DRI",
  "donation_typeDCD", "BMI_CALC", "MELD_PELD_ADJ", 
  "pre_clamp_hours", "post_clamp_hours"
)

forest_data <- bind_rows(tidy_gte50, tidy_aoos) %>%
  filter(term %in% key_vars) %>%
  mutate(
    term_label = case_when(
      term == "BMI_DON_CALC_donor" ~ "Donor BMI (per 5 kg/m²)",
      term == "DRI" ~ "Donor Risk Index (per 0.5)",
      term == "donation_typeDCD" ~ "DCD (vs DBD)",
      term == "BMI_CALC" ~ "Recipient BMI (per 5 kg/m²)",
      term == "MELD_PELD_ADJ" ~ "MELD score (per 5 points)",
      term == "pre_clamp_hours" ~ "Pre-clamp hours (per 4 hours)",
      term == "post_clamp_hours" ~ "Post-clamp time (per 30 minutes)",
      TRUE ~ term
    ),
    term_order = case_when(
      term == "MELD_PELD_ADJ" ~ 1,
      term == "donation_typeDCD" ~ 2,
      term == "DRI" ~ 3,
      term == "BMI_DON_CALC_donor" ~ 4,
      term == "BMI_CALC" ~ 5,
      term == "pre_clamp_hours" ~ 6,
      term == "post_clamp_hours" ~ 7,
      TRUE ~ 999
    )
  )

categorical_vars <- c(
  "MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_binned", "LI_FIBROSIS_collapsed", 
  "AGE_DON_binned", "AGE_binned",
  "SGOT_DON_binned", "SGPT_DON_binned", "TBILI_DON_binned", "CREAT_DON_binned"
)

cat_data <- bind_rows(tidy_gte50, tidy_aoos) %>%
  filter(grepl(paste(categorical_vars, collapse = "|"), term)) %>%
  mutate(
    variable_group = case_when(
      grepl("MACRO_FAT", term) ~ "Donor Macrosteatosis",
      grepl("LI_FIBROSIS", term) ~ "Donor Fibrosis",
      grepl("AGE_DON_binned", term) ~ "Donor Age",
      grepl("^AGE_binned", term) ~ "Recipient Age",
      grepl("SGOT_DON", term) ~ "Donor AST",
      grepl("SGPT_DON", term) ~ "Donor ALT",
      grepl("TBILI_DON", term) ~ "Donor Bilirubin",
      grepl("CREAT_DON", term) ~ "Donor Creatinine"
    ),
    level = case_when(
      grepl("MACRO_FAT.*10-30", term) ~ "10-30%",
      grepl("MACRO_FAT.*30-60", term) ~ "30-60%",

      grepl("MACRO_FAT.*Unknown", term) ~ "Unknown",
      grepl("FIBROSIS.*Mild", term) ~ "Mild",

      grepl("FIBROSIS.*Unknown", term) ~ "Unknown",
      grepl("AGE_DON.*40-49", term) ~ "40-49",
      grepl("AGE_DON.*50-59", term) ~ "50-59",
      grepl("AGE_DON.*60-69", term) ~ "60-69",
      grepl("AGE_DON.*≥70", term) ~ "≥70",
      grepl("^AGE_binned.*40-49", term) ~ "40-49",

      grepl("SGOT.*Mild", term) ~ "Mild",
      grepl("SGOT.*Moderate", term) ~ "Moderate",
      grepl("SGOT.*Severe", term) ~ "Severe",
      grepl("SGPT.*Mild", term) ~ "Mild",
      grepl("SGPT.*Moderate", term) ~ "Moderate",

    variable_group = factor(variable_group,

  )

# Exclusion Summary Table
exclusion_summary_table <- exclusion_tracker %>%
  filter(n_excluded > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    step_number = row_number(),
    n_excluded_formatted = comma(n_excluded),
    n_remaining_formatted = comma(n_remaining),
    percent_excluded = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * n_excluded / starting_n)
  ) %>%
  select(
    `Step` = step_number,
    `Exclusion Reason` = reason,
    `N Excluded` = n_excluded_formatted,
    `N Remaining` = n_remaining_formatted,
    `% of Original` = percent_excluded
  )

# Final Cohort Distribution Table
final_cohort_table <- tibble(
  `Allocation Group` = c("<50 sequence", "≥50 sequence", "AOOS (out-of-sequence)", "**Total**"),

    comma(sum(multinom_data$seq_flag == "<50 sequence")),

    sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * mean(multinom_data$seq_flag == "AOOS (out-of-sequence)")),

)
```

# SUPPLEMENT

## Table S1: Survival Outcomes by Donor Type and Sequence Group

```{r tableS1-survival-stats}
extract_surv_stats <- function(fit, data, time_var, status_var, times = c(1, 3, 5)) {
  ne <- data %>%
    count(seq_flag, name = "n") %>%
    left_join(
      data %>%
        group_by(seq_flag) %>%
        summarise(events = sum(.data[[status_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
      by = "seq_flag"
    )
  
  s <- summary(fit, times = times)
  surv_at_times <- tibble(
    seq_flag = sub("^seq_flag=", "", s$strata),
    time = s$time,
    surv = s$surv,
    lower = s$lower,
    upper = s$upper
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      surv_ci = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f–%.1f%%)", surv*100, lower*100, upper*100)
    ) %>%
    select(seq_flag, time, surv_ci) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = surv_ci, names_prefix = "yr_")
  
  lr <- survdiff(reformulate("seq_flag", response = paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", status_var, ")")), data = data)
  lr_p <- 1 - pchisq(lr$chisq, df = length(lr$n) - 1)
  
  list(
    ne = ne,
    surv_at_times = surv_at_times,
    logrank_p = lr_p
  )
}

stats_patient_dcd <- extract_surv_stats(fit_patient_dcd, surv_dcd, "PTIME_yrs", "PSTATUS")
stats_graft_dcd <- extract_surv_stats(fit_graft_dcd, surv_dcd, "GTIME_yrs", "GSTATUS")
stats_patient_dbd <- extract_surv_stats(fit_patient_dbd, surv_dbd, "PTIME_yrs", "PSTATUS")
stats_graft_dbd <- extract_surv_stats(fit_graft_dbd, surv_dbd, "GTIME_yrs", "GSTATUS")

make_surv_table <- function(stats, label) {
  stats$ne %>%
    left_join(stats$surv_at_times, by = "seq_flag") %>%
    mutate(comparison = label) %>%
    select(comparison, seq_flag, n, events, yr_1, yr_3, yr_5)
}

surv_summary_df <- bind_rows(
  make_surv_table(stats_patient_dcd, "DCD Patient"),
  make_surv_table(stats_graft_dcd, "DCD Graft"),

)
```

```{r tableS2-ph-test}
cox_patient_dcd <- coxph(Surv(PTIME_yrs, PSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dcd)
cox_graft_dcd <- coxph(Surv(GTIME_yrs, GSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dcd)
cox_patient_dbd <- coxph(Surv(PTIME_yrs, PSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dbd)
cox_graft_dbd <- coxph(Surv(GTIME_yrs, GSTATUS) ~ seq_flag, data = surv_dbd)

ph_patient_dcd <- cox.zph(cox_patient_dcd)
ph_graft_dcd <- cox.zph(cox_graft_dcd)
ph_patient_dbd <- cox.zph(cox_patient_dbd)
ph_graft_dbd <- cox.zph(cox_graft_dbd)

ph_summary <- tibble(
  Comparison = c("DCD Patient", "DCD Graft", "DBD Patient", "DBD Graft"),
  `Global p-value` = c(
    ph_patient_dcd$table["GLOBAL", "p"],
    ph_graft_dcd$table["GLOBAL", "p"],
    ph_patient_dbd$table["GLOBAL", "p"],
    ph_graft_dbd$table["GLOBAL", "p"]
  ),
  `PH Assumption` = ifelse(`Global p-value` > 0.05, "Met (p>0.05)", "Violated (p≤0.05)")
) %>%
  mutate(`Global p-value` = sprintf("%.4f", `Global p-value`))

# Store the gt table in a variable
ph_table <- ph_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table S2. Proportional Hazards Assumption Testing",
    subtitle = "Schoenfeld residuals test for each comparison"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#FFE6E6"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = `PH Assumption`,
      rows = str_detect(`PH Assumption`, "Violated")
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", size = px(12)),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(size = px(12)),
    locations = cells_body()
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.names = "Arial",
    table.font.size = px(12)
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Based on Schoenfeld residuals test. PH assumption is considered met if global p>0.05.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = `PH Assumption`)
  )

# Pass the gt object to render_tbl
render_tbl(ph_table)
```

## Table S3: Cox Proportional Hazards Models

```{r tableS3-cox-models}
format_p <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    p < 0.01 ~ sprintf("%.3f", p),
    TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", p)
  )
}

format_cox <- function(model, label) {
  broom::tidy(model, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      comparison = label,
      hr_ci = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
      p_formatted = format_p(p.value)
    ) %>%
    select(comparison, term, hr_ci, p_formatted)
}

cox_table <- bind_rows(
  format_cox(cox_patient_dcd, "DCD Patient"),
  format_cox(cox_graft_dcd, "DCD Graft"),
  format_cox(cox_patient_dbd, "DBD Patient"),
  format_cox(cox_graft_dbd, "DBD Graft")
) %>%
  mutate(term = str_remove(term, "seq_flag")) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table S3. Unadjusted Hazard Ratios by Sequence Group",
    subtitle = "Reference: <50 sequence"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    comparison = "Outcome",
    term = "Group",
    hr_ci = "HR (95% CI)",
    p_formatted = "P-value"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", size = px(12)),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(size = px(12)),
    locations = cells_body()
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.names = "Arial",
    table.font.size = px(12)
  )

render_tbl(cox_table)
```

**Table S3.** Cox proportional hazards modelling of survival data for DCD and DBD patient & graft survival expressing Hazard ratios with 95% confidence intervals and p-values. Note DBD graft & patient violated PH assumptions and so RMST are reported in table S4. DCD graft survival in AOOS was the only significant hazard ratio of 1.21, p=0.02 for increased hazard of graft failure relative to <50 sequence.

## Table S4: Restricted Mean Survival Time 

```{r-table_s4_rmst}

library(survRM2)

# Function to extract key RMST results
extract_rmst_summary <- function(data, time_var, status_var, tau = 5) {
  
  # Predefine empty results table with consistent column types
  results <- data.frame(
    Comparison = character(),
    RMST_Diff = numeric(),
    CI_Lower = numeric(),
    CI_Upper = numeric(),
    P_Value = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Loop through comparison groups
  for (grp in c("≥50 sequence", "AOOS (out-of-sequence)")) {
    comp_data <- data %>% 
      filter(seq_flag %in% c("<50 sequence", grp)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[status_var]])) %>%
      mutate(arm = as.numeric(seq_flag != "<50 sequence"))
    
    # Skip if group too small or identical
    if (nrow(comp_data) == 0 || length(unique(comp_data$arm)) < 2) next
    
    tryCatch({
      rmst_obj <- rmst2(
        time = comp_data[[time_var]],
        status = comp_data[[status_var]],
        arm = comp_data$arm,
        tau = tau
      )
      
      # Extract numeric values
      diff <- as.numeric(rmst_obj$unadjusted.result[1, c("Est.", "lower .95", "upper .95", "p")])
      
      results <- rbind(
        results,
        data.frame(
          Comparison = grp,
          RMST_Diff = round(diff[1], 3),
          CI_Lower   = round(diff[2], 3),
          CI_Upper   = round(diff[3], 3),
          P_Value    = round(diff[4], 3),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      )
      
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  
  return(results)
}


# Check for PH violations
ph_violated <- c(
  dcd_patient = ph_patient_dcd$table["GLOBAL", "p"] <= 0.05,
  dcd_graft = ph_graft_dcd$table["GLOBAL", "p"] <= 0.05,
  dbd_patient = ph_patient_dbd$table["GLOBAL", "p"] <= 0.05,
  dbd_graft = ph_graft_dbd$table["GLOBAL", "p"] <= 0.05
)

if (any(ph_violated)) {
  
  # Create results frame
  rmst_summary <- data.frame()
  
  if (ph_violated["dbd_patient"]) {
    temp <- extract_rmst_summary(surv_dbd, "PTIME_yrs", "PSTATUS", tau = 5)
    temp$Outcome <- "DBD Patient Survival"
    rmst_summary <- rbind(rmst_summary, temp)
  }
  
  if (ph_violated["dbd_graft"]) {
    temp <- extract_rmst_summary(surv_dbd, "GTIME_yrs", "GSTATUS", tau = 5)
    temp$Outcome <- "DBD Graft Survival"
    rmst_summary <- rbind(rmst_summary, temp)
  }
  
  if (ph_violated["dcd_patient"]) {
    temp <- extract_rmst_summary(surv_dcd, "PTIME_yrs", "PSTATUS", tau = 5)
    temp$Outcome <- "DCD Patient Survival"
    rmst_summary <- rbind(rmst_summary, temp)
  }
  
  if (ph_violated["dcd_graft"]) {
    temp <- extract_rmst_summary(surv_dcd, "GTIME_yrs", "GSTATUS", tau = 5)
    temp$Outcome <- "DCD Graft Survival"
    rmst_summary <- rbind(rmst_summary, temp)
  }
  
  # Reorder columns
  rmst_summary <- rmst_summary[, c("Outcome", "Comparison", "RMST_Diff", "CI_Lower", "CI_Upper", "P_Value")]
  
  # Print table
  knitr::kable(
    rmst_summary, 
    col.names = c("Outcome", "Comparison", "RMST Difference (years)", "95% CI Lower", "95% CI Upper", "P-value"),
    caption = "Restricted Mean Survival Time Differences (τ = 5 years)",
    digits = 3
  )

} else {
  # Add message if none violated
  message("PH assumption met for all models – RMST not required.")
}

```

**Table S4.** For analyses where proportional hazards was violated, RMST differences are presented = average survival time up to 5 years. Positive values favor the comparison group. No significant differences between survival groups for DBD patient and graft survival noted.

## Table S5: Graft Survival Statistics by Cross-Clamp Timing

```{r tableS5-graft-xc-stats}
p_logrank <- function(dat, time_var, status_var) {
  sd <- survdiff(reformulate("clamp_timing", response = paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", status_var, ")")), data = dat)
  df <- length(sd$n) - 1
  1 - pchisq(sd$chisq, df = df)
}
show_km <- function(fit, label) {
  s <- summary(fit, times = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1))
  tibble(
    Group = sub("^clamp_timing=", "", s$strata),
    Time = s$time,
    Survival = sprintf("%.1f%%", s$surv * 100),
    `95% CI` = sprintf("%.1f–%.1f%%", s$lower * 100, s$upper * 100)
  ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Time,
      values_from = c(Survival, `95% CI`),
      names_glue = "{.value} {Time*12} mo"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Comparison = label, .before = 1)
}
graft_stats <- bind_rows(
  show_km(fit_g_dcd_oos, "DCD AOOS Graft"),
  show_km(fit_g_dbd_oos, "DBD AOOS Graft"),
  show_km(fit_g_dcd_seq, "DCD Sequential Graft"),
  show_km(fit_g_dbd_seq, "DBD Sequential Graft")
) %>%
  mutate(`Log-rank p` = c(
    rep(sprintf("%.4f", p_logrank(dcd_oos, "GTIME_1yr", "GSTATUS_1yr")), 2),
    rep(sprintf("%.4f", p_logrank(dbd_oos, "GTIME_1yr", "GSTATUS_1yr")), 2),
    rep(sprintf("%.4f", p_logrank(dcd_seq, "GTIME_1yr", "GSTATUS_1yr")), 2),
    rep(sprintf("%.4f", p_logrank(dbd_seq, "GTIME_1yr", "GSTATUS_1yr")), 2)
  ))

render_tbl(graft_stats)
```

```{r tableS6-patient-xc-stats}
    rep(sprintf("%.4f", p_logrank(dcd_seq, "PTIME_1yr", "PSTATUS_1yr")), 2),
    rep(sprintf("%.4f", p_logrank(dbd_seq, "PTIME_1yr", "PSTATUS_1yr")), 2)
  ))

render_tbl(patient_stats)
```

**Table S6**.  Patient survival percentages pre- and post- cross-clamp with 95% confidence intervals at 3-month, 6-month, 9-month and 12-months respectively with log-rank p values. Data presented for AOOS and sequential allocation pathways.

**Table S9** OPO and Listing Center Variables introduced as fixed effects into Model B. Reference categories were selected as the highest volume OPO (01054, n=2,402 transplants) and listing center (07223, n=1,394 transplants). The choice of reference category is a reparameterization that does not affect model fit, statistical significance of other variables, or tests of institutional variation. All coefficients for other OPOs and listing centers are interpreted relative to the highest-volume for interpretability purposes.

```{r fit-multinomial-models, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
cat("Fitting Model B: Adding OPO and listing center...\n")

# Set reference categories to highest volume centers
# OPO: 01054 (2402 cases) - highest volume
# LISTING: 07223 (1394 cases) - highest volume

multinom_data$OPO_CTR_CODE <- relevel(factor(multinom_data$OPO_CTR_CODE), ref = "01054")
multinom_data$LISTING_CTR_CODE <- relevel(factor(multinom_data$LISTING_CTR_CODE), ref = "07223")

model_full <- multinom(
  seq_flag ~ 
    # Clinical factors (same as above)
    TX_YEAR + AGE_DON_binned + BMI_DON_CALC_donor + 
    SGOT_DON_binned + SGPT_DON_binned + TBILI_DON_binned + CREAT_DON_binned +
    donation_type + DRI + DSRI +
    HCV_NAT_DON + HEP_C_ANTI_DON + CDC_RISK_HIV_DON + HBV_CORE_DON +
    MACRO_FAT_LI_DON_binned + LI_FIBROSIS_collapsed +
    DEATH_CIRCUM_DON_collapsed + DEATH_MECH_DON_collapsed +
    GENDER_DON_donor + ABO_DON + ALCOHOL_HEAVY_DON_donor +
    CLIN_INFECT_DON + HIST_DIABETES_DON + HIST_HYPERTENS_DON +
    HIST_CANCER_DON + HIST_CAD + SODIUM170_VAL_DON + BLOOD_INF_DON +
    AGE_binned + GENDER + ETHCAT + BMI_CALC + MELD_PELD_ADJ +
    ASCITES_TX + ENCEPH_TX + DIAB + DAYSWAIT_CHRON +
    pre_clamp_hours + post_clamp_hours +
    # Institutional
    OPO_CTR_CODE + LISTING_CTR_CODE,
  data = multinom_data,
  maxit = 1000,
  trace = FALSE
)

cat("✓ Model B converged.\n")


# Check model fitted values
cat("\nDiagnosing model data usage:\n")
cat("  multinom_data rows:", nrow(multinom_data), "\n")
cat("  model_clinical fitted rows:", length(fitted(model_clinical)[,1]), "\n")
cat("  model_full fitted rows:", length(fitted(model_full)[,1]), "\n")

# If models dropped rows, create subset
if (length(fitted(model_clinical)[,1]) != nrow(multinom_data)) {
  cat("  WARNING: Model A dropped observations. Creating subset...\n")
  model_clinical_indices <- as.numeric(names(fitted(model_clinical)[,1]))
  multinom_data_clinical <- multinom_data[model_clinical_indices, ]
} else {
  multinom_data_clinical <- multinom_data
}

if (length(fitted(model_full)[,1]) != nrow(multinom_data)) {
  cat("  WARNING: Model B dropped observations. Creating subset...\n")
  model_full_indices <- as.numeric(names(fitted(model_full)[,1]))
  multinom_data_full <- multinom_data[model_full_indices, ]
} else {
  multinom_data_full <- multinom_data
}

cat("  Final Model A data:", nrow(multinom_data_clinical), "\n")
cat("  Final Model B data:", nrow(multinom_data_full), "\n\n")

# Likelihood ratio test
lr_test <- anova(model_clinical, model_full)

cat("\n=== LIKELIHOOD RATIO TEST ===\n")
cat("Testing joint significance of OPO and listing center effects\n\n")
print(lr_test)

# Calculate AICs
aic_clinical <- AIC(model_clinical)
aic_full <- AIC(model_full)

cat("\n=== MODEL COMPARISON ===\n")
cat("Model A (Clinical only) AIC:", round(aic_clinical, 1), "\n")
cat("Model B (+ Institutional) AIC:", round(aic_full, 1), "\n")
cat("AIC improvement:", round(aic_clinical - aic_full, 1), "\n\n")

# Predictions
pred_clinical <- predict(model_clinical, type = "class")
pred_full <- predict(model_full, type = "class")

# Confusion matrices
conf_clinical <- table(Predicted = pred_clinical, Actual = multinom_data_clinical$seq_flag)
conf_full <- table(Predicted = pred_full, Actual = multinom_data_full$seq_flag)

# Calculate metrics for Model A
acc_clinical <- sum(diag(conf_clinical)) / sum(conf_clinical)
sens_lt50_clinical <- conf_clinical[1,1] / sum(conf_clinical[,1])
sens_gte50_clinical <- conf_clinical[2,2] / sum(conf_clinical[,2])
sens_aoos_clinical <- conf_clinical[3,3] / sum(conf_clinical[,3])

spec_lt50_clinical <- sum(conf_clinical[-1,-1]) / sum(conf_clinical[,-1])
spec_gte50_clinical <- (conf_clinical[1,1] + conf_clinical[3,1] + conf_clinical[1,3] + conf_clinical[3,3]) / 
  (sum(conf_clinical) - sum(conf_clinical[,2]))
spec_aoos_clinical <- (conf_clinical[1,1] + conf_clinical[2,1] + conf_clinical[1,2] + conf_clinical[2,2]) / 
  (sum(conf_clinical) - sum(conf_clinical[,3]))

# Calculate metrics for Model B
acc_full <- sum(diag(conf_full)) / sum(conf_full)
sens_lt50_full <- conf_full[1,1] / sum(conf_full[,1])
sens_gte50_full <- conf_full[2,2] / sum(conf_full[,2])
sens_aoos_full <- conf_full[3,3] / sum(conf_full[,3])

spec_lt50_full <- sum(conf_full[-1,-1]) / sum(conf_full[,-1])
spec_gte50_full <- (conf_full[1,1] + conf_full[3,1] + conf_full[1,3] + conf_full[3,3]) / 
  (sum(conf_full) - sum(conf_full[,2]))
spec_aoos_full <- (conf_full[1,1] + conf_full[2,1] + conf_full[1,2] + conf_full[2,2]) / 
  (sum(conf_full) - sum(conf_full[,3]))


# ============================================================================
# CONFUSION MATRICES AND PERFORMANCE METRICS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== MODEL A: CONFUSION MATRIX ===\n")
print(conf_clinical)
cat("\n")

cat("MODEL A PERFORMANCE:\n")
cat("  Overall Accuracy:", percent(acc_clinical, accuracy = 0.1), "\n\n")
cat("  <50 sequence:\n")
cat("    Sensitivity:", percent(sens_lt50_clinical, accuracy = 0.1), "\n")
cat("    Specificity:", percent(spec_lt50_clinical, accuracy = 0.1), "\n\n")
cat("  ≥50 sequence:\n")
cat("    Sensitivity:", percent(sens_gte50_clinical, accuracy = 0.1), "\n")
cat("    Specificity:", percent(spec_gte50_clinical, accuracy = 0.1), "\n\n")
cat("  AOOS:\n")
cat("    Sensitivity:", percent(sens_aoos_clinical, accuracy = 0.1), "\n")
cat("    Specificity:", percent(spec_aoos_clinical, accuracy = 0.1), "\n\n")

cat("\n=== MODEL B: CONFUSION MATRIX ===\n")
print(conf_full)
cat("\n")

cat("MODEL B PERFORMANCE:\n")
cat("  Overall Accuracy:", percent(acc_full, accuracy = 0.1), "\n\n")
cat("  <50 sequence:\n")
cat("    Sensitivity:", percent(sens_lt50_full, accuracy = 0.1), "\n")
cat("    Specificity:", percent(spec_lt50_full, accuracy = 0.1), "\n\n")
cat("  ≥50 sequence:\n")
cat("    Sensitivity:", percent(sens_gte50_full, accuracy = 0.1), "\n")
cat("    Specificity:", percent(spec_gte50_full, accuracy = 0.1), "\n\n")
cat("  AOOS:\n")
cat("    Sensitivity:", percent(sens_aoos_full, accuracy = 0.1), "\n")
cat("    Specificity:", percent(spec_aoos_full, accuracy = 0.1), "\n")


# ============================================================================
# CREATE TABLES FOR LATER DISPLAY
# ============================================================================

# Model Comparison Table
model_comparison_table <- tibble(
  Model = c("Model A (Clinical only)", "Model B (+ Institutional)"),
  AIC = c(round(aic_clinical, 1), round(aic_full, 1)),
  `Overall Accuracy` = c(
    sprintf("%.1f%%", acc_clinical * 100),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", acc_full * 100)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    `AIC Improvement` = c("—", sprintf("%.1f", aic_clinical - aic_full))
  )


# Performance Metrics Table - Model A
performance_A_table <- tibble(
  `Allocation Group` = c("<50 sequence", "≥50 sequence", "AOOS (out-of-sequence)"),
  Sensitivity = c(
    sprintf("%.1f%%", sens_lt50_clinical * 100),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", sens_gte50_clinical * 100),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", sens_aoos_clinical * 100)
  ),
  Specificity = c(
    sprintf("%.1f%%", spec_lt50_clinical * 100),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", spec_gte50_clinical * 100),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", spec_aoos_clinical * 100)
  )
)

# Performance Metrics Table - Model B
performance_B_table <- tibble(
  `Allocation Group` = c("<50 sequence", "≥50 sequence", "AOOS (out-of-sequence)"),
  Sensitivity = c(
    sprintf("%.1f%%", sens_lt50_full * 100),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", sens_gte50_full * 100),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", sens_aoos_full * 100)
  ),
  Specificity = c(
    sprintf("%.1f%%", spec_lt50_full * 100),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", spec_gte50_full * 100),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", spec_aoos_full * 100)
  )
)

# Confusion Matrix - Model A (formatted)
confusion_A_table <- as.data.frame.matrix(conf_clinical) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Predicted") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), comma))

# Confusion Matrix - Model B (formatted)
confusion_B_table <- as.data.frame.matrix(conf_full) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Predicted") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), comma))
```

#Table S17: Coefficient tables for Model A (Clinical only)

```{r model-A-coefficients}
# MODEL A (Clinical only)
coef_matrix_A <- coef(model_clinical)
se_matrix_A <- summary(model_clinical)$standard.errors
z_matrix_A <- coef_matrix_A / se_matrix_A
p_matrix_A <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_matrix_A)))

# Calculate DSRI decile
dsri_decile <- quantile(multinom_data$DSRI, 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)

# Increment map
increment_map <- c(
  "BMI_DON_CALC_donor" = 5,
  "DRI" = 0.5,
  "DSRI" = dsri_decile,
  "BMI_CALC" = 5,
  "MELD_PELD_ADJ" = 5,
  "DAYSWAIT_CHRON" = 180,
  "pre_clamp_hours" = 4,
  "post_clamp_hours" = 1
)

# Function to rescale RRRs
rescale_rrr <- function(coef, se, term) {
  if (term %in% names(increment_map)) {
    increment <- increment_map[term]
    scaled_coef <- coef * increment
    scaled_se <- se * increment
  } else {
    scaled_coef <- coef
    scaled_se <- se
  }
  
  list(
    rrr = exp(scaled_coef),
    rrr_ci_low = exp(scaled_coef - 1.96 * scaled_se),
    rrr_ci_high = exp(scaled_coef + 1.96 * scaled_se)
  )
}

# Create tidy tables for Model A
tidy_gte50_A <- tibble(
  term = rownames(t(coef_matrix_A)),
  coefficient = coef_matrix_A[1, ],
  se = se_matrix_A[1, ],
  z = z_matrix_A[1, ],
  p = p_matrix_A[1, ]
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    scaled = list(rescale_rrr(coefficient, se, term)),
    rrr = scaled$rrr,
    rrr_ci_low = scaled$rrr_ci_low,
    rrr_ci_high = scaled$rrr_ci_high
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-scaled) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = "≥50 vs <50 sequence",
    rrr_display = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", rrr, rrr_ci_low, rrr_ci_high),
    p_display = case_when(
      p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      p < 0.01 ~ sprintf("%.3f", p),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", p)
    ),
    significant = p < 0.05
  )

tidy_aoos_A <- tibble(
  term = rownames(t(coef_matrix_A)),
  coefficient = coef_matrix_A[2, ],
  se = se_matrix_A[2, ],
  z = z_matrix_A[2, ],
  p = p_matrix_A[2, ]
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    scaled = list(rescale_rrr(coefficient, se, term)),
    rrr = scaled$rrr,
    rrr_ci_low = scaled$rrr_ci_low,
    rrr_ci_high = scaled$rrr_ci_high
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-scaled) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = "AOOS vs <50 sequence",
    rrr_display = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", rrr, rrr_ci_low, rrr_ci_high),
    p_display = case_when(
      p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      p < 0.01 ~ sprintf("%.3f", p),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", p)
    ),
    significant = p < 0.05
  )

# Coefficient table for Model A
coef_table_A <- bind_rows(tidy_gte50_A, tidy_aoos_A) %>%
  select(comparison, term, rrr_display, p_display, significant) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "comparison") %>%
  cols_label(
    term = "Variable",
    rrr_display = "RRR (95% CI)",
    p_display = "P-value",
    significant = "Sig"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#FFF3CD"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = significant == TRUE)
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Reference category: <50 sequence. Continuous variables rescaled to clinically meaningful increments.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = term)
  ) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = significant)

coef_table_A
```
